title: Comparison of NOM for ACLD Between Medical and Surgical Ward
official: Acute Left Colon Diverticulitis: is it Still a Surgical Disease When Only Medical Treatment is Required? A Retrospective Study Based on Propensity Score Matching
summary: In Europe, patients with acute left colon diverticulitis (ALCD) are usually admitted to surgical wards even when only medical treatment is required. The study compares ALCD non-operative management (NOM) between surgical and non-surgical environments regarding clinical outcomes, hospitalization length(LOS), and follow-up.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients affected by ALCD using a contrast-enhanced CT scan at admission undergoing NOM

Exclusion Criteria:

* immediate indication for surgery (i.e. patients with Hinchey III or IV ALCD or septic patients with Hinchey II)
